conventions.onset_ms: position of the main transient: 5.0 ms in gunshot groups, 2.0 ms in every other one-shot, null for loops and impulse responses
conventions.onset_rule: global_peak_10pct = first sample where the 0.5 ms moving average of max(|L|,|R|) exceeds 10 % of its peak over the whole file, refined to the steepest rise within +-0.15 ms; first_transient_10pct(60ms) = same, but the reference peak is the maximum of the first 60 ms of the file (multi-part events: the first transient is aligned, the loudest part comes later - see peak_ms); reference_only = file is aligned to its parent's timeline and contains no transient at onset_ms
conventions.onset_check_ms: onset re-measured on the written file by tools/build/audio/g99_manifest.py
conventions.levels: peak_dbfs = sample peak, rms_dbfs = RMS over the whole file (all channels), lufs = ITU-R BS.1770-4 integrated; files shorter than one 400 ms gating block are measured ungated over the whole file (stated in notes). Mono files are measured as one channel.
conventions.gain_db: gain applied relative to the (resampled, filtered) source
conventions.normalisation: one common gain per group (loudest file peaks at -1.0 dBFS) unless the group description says otherwise; nothing is normalised per file
conventions.format: WAV 48 kHz 16-bit PCM with TPDF dither; ambience loops OGG Vorbis q7
